fusions.name: Dragging Tines
fusions.desc: A dragging blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Heaped Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a heap of leavings that deals 26 earth damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts for 80% of that on every enemy within 3 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gather In
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Leavings Gathered
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
